cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Don’t Go
cards.instruction: Create reasons another player must stay with you. Never directly ask them to stay.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Before you zip your suitcase, let me wrap that jar of jam. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's already wrapped in my jumper.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. That's your train jumper. We'll need to unpack it and find something else.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then you haven't tasted it. I'll get a spoon before you decide.
